franchise: TT Isle of Man: Ride on the Edge
era: Modern Isle of Man TT motorcycle simulation
summary: Kylotonn/RaceWard/Nacon's modern Isle of Man TT racing trilogy, reviving the license on HD and modern console/PC platforms.

entries.title: TT Isle of Man: Ride on the Edge
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with owned DLC

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC release at highest stable settings

primary.version: PC release with DLC if owned
primary.why: The first Ride on the Edge released on Windows, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One. Windows is the highest-fidelity configurable route, and the Steam release includes the faithful 37.73-mile Snaefell Mountain course, 25 riders, 38 bikes, online competition for up to eight players, and DLC routes such as Sidecar Thrill and King of the Mountain.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows/Steam version at the highest stable settings with owned DLC installed; use PS4 or Xbox One only as access alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: DLC such as Sidecar Thrill and King of the Mountain should be installed if preserving all official add-on content.

entries.title: TT Isle of Man: Ride on the Edge 2

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Ride on the Edge 2 released on Windows, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch. The Steam release includes reworked physics, classic motorcycles, and an open-world structure; Windows is the highest-fidelity configurable route, while Switch is a lower-fidelity portable access route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows/Steam version at the highest stable settings; use console/Switch versions only as access alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced complete edition beyond the listed releases.

entries.title: TT Isle of Man: Ride on the Edge 3
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with owned DLC

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC release at highest stable settings

primary.version: PC release with DLC if owned
primary.why: Ride on the Edge 3 released on Windows, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch. The Steam release includes official latest-TT content, 38 riders, 32 circuits, over 200 km of roads, an open world, online multiplayer, and DLC including the 2023 TT Races Roster. Windows is the most configurable high-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows/Steam version at the highest stable settings with owned DLC installed; use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S only as strong console alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: DLC such as the 2023 TT Races Roster and John McGuinness livery should be installed if preserving all official add-on content.
